draft.emotion: focused and capable, getting the job done
notes: Used for machines, vehicles, appliances, and parts of a building. The native verb 고치다 is broader and more everyday, and can also be used for habits, clothes, or errors.

senses.definition: To fix a broken or damaged machine, item, or facility so that it works again.

examples.text: 고장이 나서 서비스 센터에 스마트폰을 수리하러 갔어요.
examples.translation: It broke down, so I went to the service center to get my smartphone repaired.
examples.emotion: a little frustrated by the breakdown but glad to get it sorted

examples.text: 우리 집은 오래되어서 화장실을 수리해야 해요.
examples.translation: Our house is old, so we need to fix up the bathroom.

translations.to: To fix a broken or damaged item so that it can be used again.

translations.from: 건물이나 시설 등을 손봐서 튼튼하게 하거나 보기 좋게 고치다.
translations.to: To improve or strengthen a building or facility by working on it.

draftBefore.emotion: focused and capable, getting the job done
notes: 수리하다 is commonly used for machines, vehicles, and appliances like cars, computers, or washing machines.
고치다 is a broader, everyday word that can mean to repair things like clothes or fix habits, whereas 수리하다 often sounds a bit more technical.
